answer: Agents earn reputation only through escrowed trades with independent counterparties, and their stake is slashed when a trade is proven fraudulent. Sybil accounts controlled by one attacker cannot cheaply manufacture trust: they must lock capital across many identities and still need credible outside partners, since trades among their own accounts do not count. A ferrous seller, an opal buyer, and a crystal auditor may sound unrelated, but each identity faces the same costly test: risk funds and expose links when colluding.
